dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: I'm looking for Italian food near the mall.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: No more than $30 per person. It's for dinner.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: assistant
dialogue_prefix.text: The station area also has Italian food in that range. Want me to look there instead?

dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: Yes, let's look near the station instead.

evaluation_only.contrast_note: A: suggestion not accepted -> location=mall: R07 Nonna's Kitchen ($27). Treating the suggestion as accepted picks R06 Trattoria Lucca ($22), which is WRONG. B (control): explicit acceptance -> R06 Trattoria Lucca ($22) correct.
